name: Beheaded Swashbuckler's Jacket
description:
The Dullahan rides with a lantern grin,
His severed head tucked snug within.

name: Beheaded Warden's Tower Shield
description:
A frightful sight, yet oddly spry,
A ghost who winks as he passes by.

name: Beheaded Zwei-fencer's Cuirass
description:
Horses snort sparks, their hooves strike flame,
He calls no soul, yet whispers your name.

name: Crystal Staff

name: Cursed Spine Shard
description:
The air grows still, the candles dim,
As mortals dream and think of him.
A trickster, herald, phantom, friend,
Whose tale begins but will not end.

So mind the road where shadows play,
For Dullahan may pass your way.
He brings no gold, no curse, no plea,
Just riddles whispered eerily.

description:
So when the winds grow sharp and thin,
And night pulls tighter round your skin,
Take heed, take care, and hush your breath,
For Dullahan rides the roads of death.

name: Haunted Dullahan Bladed Boots
description:
He bows with grace, though crownless still,
A jester bound to fate's dark will.
He tips his skull with courtly cheer,
And whispers names for none to hear.

name: Haunted Dullahan Cloak
description:
Through misty moors the rider flies,
With hollow laugh and lantern eyes.
His severed head held firm and tight,
A beacon grim in candlelight.

name: Haunted Dullahan Skull
description:
The Dullahan rides when the moon is high,
A headless shadow against the sky.
He hums a tune both sharp and sweet,
That chills the heart with every beat.

traits: Status Effect Chance: +20% / Status Effect Duration: +1 turn

summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Serpent Pearl
description:
Charm of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

While holding this item, some your Defense and Resistance stats will be swapped. The better the quality of this item, the bigger amount of your Defense and Resistance stats will be exchanged.

description: Dark armor of elite Balor rogues.

description: Medal awarded in the Sumner Games, a storied event of Olympia.

name: Smelly Mushroom
description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will cause one to enrage, but become afflicted with Toxic.

name: Solar Secrets
description: A scroll of destructive solar magic crafted by Emile. Using it will grant the skills "Solarstrikes" and "Solarseals".

name: Songbook of Nature
description: Old Grimoire of Terra, allowing one to summon Terra's beasts.

name: Sour Mushroom
description: A mushroom of Naggeneen's collection. Eating it will greatly increase one's attack and magic powers, but become afflicted with a variety of illnesses.

name: Spelunking Staff
description: Staff of a lost dungeon explorer. It seems to have developed quite some power while resting deep within the land.

name: Spinal Whip
description:
He lifts his head as though to bow,
And tips it gently, here and now.
No crown of gold, no jeweled delight,
Just grinning teeth in ghostly white.

name: Spore
description: A spore of a toxic mushroom. Adorning it upon a weapon can add a variety of status effects to your attacks.

name: Staff of Typhon
description: A superb staff forged of the remains of Typhon, the great ancient dragon.

name: Staff of Zaltys
description: Chapter V: Zaltys never did like the Agathodaemon, but understood that she needed the soil for life. Zaltys laid seed to the soil, sprouting the foliage that lets us breath our air. Her staff represents life, and will allow you to recover HP each turn in battle.

name: Stilettos
description: A pair of unnecessarily sharp daggers. These will easily cause an opponent to bleed.

name: Symbol of Famine
description: Adornment of the First Horseman. Adorning it upon a piece of armor will slightly protect one from status ailments.

name: Ulster's Axe
description: Axe of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

name: Ulster's Crown
description:
Crown of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

The crown greatly reduces the time one will be afflicted with a negative status effect. It was a shame he was not wearing it when sampling that fated wine.

name: Ulster's Epee
description: Straight sword of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

name: Ulster's Sceptre
description:
Sceptre of a fallen King, Ulster. Ulster was King of the Seas but was poisoned by his own herbalist, Mori.

This staff will fill one Manaflask for each enemy defeated.

name: Vandal's Veil
description: A thick piece of fabric, often used to protect one's lungs. Wearing it makes one less likely to be afflicted with status effects.

name: Verrick's Ring
description: Lunar Catalyst of Verrick, fallen king of the Enlightened.

The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Eos drove a mighty chariot powered by her mighty horses, the Phaethons. She searched the continents for tower materials, never having difficulty delivering them home.

name: Heart of Oceanus
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Oceanus raised the great seas; crashing waves against the towers to test their might. He cooled the artifacts of Prometheus's Kiln, and forced the tower pieces into place with great tidal force.

This augment allows one to break the maximum damage limit.

name: Heart of Prometheus
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Prometheus operated a great kiln, molding stone, steel, and ortanite needed by the Titans into great pieces of the great towers. Ultimately, it is said his synthetic flesh became a kiln in itself.

This piece increases one's resistance to status effects.

name: Heart of Selene
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Selene had a certain way with the wildlife surrounding the towers. With the help of the birds, the trees, the hunters, and the prey -- she never felt deficient of help.

This piece will allow your follower to make more intelligent decisions in battle.

name: Heart of Themis
description:
The Olympians constructed many great Titans to construct their towers to the skies. Few titans remain animated today.

Titan Themis, of law and order, balanced the tower planes into place with her shoulders. A plane mustn't lean down to Balor, nor up to skies. A level floor bequeaths the next level floor.

This piece allows one to recover both HP and Mana when taking Ward damage.

name: Arisen Aaru Sandals
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

name: Final Decree
description:
Osiris, a man unknown to the siblings, fled Aaru not long after Ptah's departure, for he too had grand illusions of power and glory. He travelled West, following what he thought to be Gengen-Wer's trail.

And while he did not find Gengen-Wer, he found plumes of feathers, fallen from the great bird. And where these feathers lay, the power of beasts was awakened.

Kingdoms arose. First Elysium, built upon a rift to the underworld, where Osiris was destined to rule.

And as the wind took the feathers South of here, Nothren was sure to rise.

description: A salmon containing most, if not all, of the world's knowledge. The scent may draw extra monsters to you during Horde Mode dungeons, which may also have contributed to Oillipheist's stench.

name: Sarbacane
description: A deadly weapon constructed with the finest of materials and stuffed with toxic flora. This weapon carries more than darts; it carries disease itself. Each breath releases a virulent toxin said to be drawn from the deepest roots of the wild, where even the air festers. Those struck do not simply fall...They wither.

name: Scroll of Anguish
description: A scroll that summons that brutal manifestation of all trials met by heroes and travelers alike.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Scroll of Arisen Rift Distortion
description: A scroll containing mixed incantations of Riftfall. Use at your own risk.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Scroll of Dynasty
description: A piece of literature crafted by the Monumental Guild. It recalls the story of the Great Sphinx, and will summon a projection of it when read.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Scroll of Fey Jormungandr
description: A scroll containing the incantations of Ragnarok. Reading them will summon Fey Jormungandr.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Scroll of Yggdrasil
description: A scroll consisting of the lore of the great Yggdrasil. Read this scroll to summon the Yggdrasil super raid to your location.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Scroll of the Judges Trifecta
description: A scroll consisting of Elysian lore. Read this scroll to summon the Judge Trifecta Maximus super raid to your location.
summon_note: Only raids at or below your tier can be summoned.

name: Serpent Arrows

name: Swansong

name: Symbol of Doom

description: Aside: With the land constructed, Nature must come to be. Velue and Peluda extended their quills and shot them to the sky. As they fell, planted as trees, these quills became.

description:
Yelbeghen, a Dragon Titan, was created by the Draconians with the remains of the Great Dragons. They, too, wanted to reach the stars above -- but they could not get higher than 25 floors.

This light armor improves the chances of gaining another turn via Avidity, as well as increases the damage of skills that hit multiple opponents.

name: Ymir Agathodaemon Hammer
description: Chapter IV: The Agathodaemon, destructive as always, crumbled the tops of the coiled stone into earth and soil. He layed this soil over Vritra's wings, forming the ground as we know it. The Agathodaemon's hammer can crush the Ward of your opponent.

name: Ymir Beithir's Staff
description: Aside: As Illuyanka's walls were raised, protection for this new land was needed. Beithir, with the breath of lightning and claws of toxin, replicated itself indefinitely. An army of Dragons was created in an instant.

name: Ymir Brilliant Feathers
description: Chapter IX: Quetzalcoatl flew high, shedding her feathers in the air. As the sun melted her feathers, they filled the craters Bashe left behind, forming our lakes and rivers. Her remaining feathers form this scythe, and it will better align you with your faction's might.

name: Ymir Cliffside Cuirass
description: Chapter VI: Illuyanka then raised walls of stone to frame this new land from the raging seas and winds. The cliffs and shores can be seen from afar, and her mighty armor will surely make one feel as they are made of the cliffs themselves. It will occasionally protect you from hits that take 100% of your maximum HP.
traits: Damage Protect: 100% Max HP Damage (25% chance)

name: Ymir Coiled Shield
description: Chapter I: These lands were created by the Great Dragons: 8 deities formed by the wants and wishes of humankind. Lotan was the first to mend the earth, coiling rock from the planet's core to create the foundation of life. Her shield will greatly decrease the damage taken when defending in battle.

name: Ymir Staff of Zaltys
description: Chapter V: Zaltys never did like the Agathodaemon, but understood that she needed the soil for life. Zaltys laid seed to the soil, sprouting the foliage that lets us breath our air. Her staff represents life, and will allow you to recover HP each turn in battle.

name: Ymir Vritra Charm
description: Chapter III: Vritra was next to forge these lands, laying her immutable wings upon the coiled rock. This formed a basin of strength for life to grow atop the molten core of this planet. Her charm may occasionally protect you from status effects while granting immunity to Paralyze, Stun, and Petrification.

name: Ymir World Eater
description: Chapter VIII: Bashe, the World Eater -- hungry as ever -- drove his mouth downwards, piercing the foundation of the Agathodaemon. His broadsword is filled with craters as well, making it well suitable for adornment.

name: Zagreus Bident
description: Weapon of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus carried two items -- one polearm and one net.

name: Zagreus Chestplate
description: Gear of Zagreus, fallen Judge of Elysium. Zagreus was once a Judge of Elysium, but was later banished to the Dark Rift. His followers followed him to the Underworld below.

traits: Bonus Shackled Ascension Levels: 5 / Shackled Rewards: +15%
